text: dsh-mermaid-image-preview 是供 DSH Web 客户端使用的 Mermaid 图表预览插件：它从已完成的助手回复中识别 Mermaid 代码块，并在回复下方显示图像。插件在 DSH 主机中通过 mermaid 与 svgdom 本地渲染，支持跟随界面明暗主题、点击放大图像，并可调整收起预览的高度。可配置外部渲染服务器，在关闭本地渲染或启用回退且本地渲染失败时使用。适合希望直接查看对话中流程图和其他 Mermaid 图表的用户；默认无需 API 密钥，外部回退使用配置的渲染服务器。

dsh-mermaid-image-preview renders Mermaid blocks from completed assistant replies as images beneath them in the DSH Web client. It uses the host’s local renderer, follows the interface theme, supports click to enlarge, and offers a configurable external fallback. No API key is required by default.

dsh-mermaid-image-preview 的功能「对话图表预览」：从已完成的助手回复提取 mermaid 或 mmd 代码块，并在回复下方渲染图像。图像按界面主题呈现，可点击放大。
dsh-mermaid-image-preview 的功能「本地与备用渲染」：默认通过 DSH 主机的本地渲染路由生成 SVG；可关闭本地渲染或启用失败回退，并配置渲染服务器。
dsh-mermaid-image-preview 的功能「预览高度设置」：在插件页面编辑收起状态下图像的最大高度，保存后写入 localStorage，并立即应用到预览。
dsh-mermaid-image-preview 使用外部回退渲染时，会把图表代码编码进发往配置渲染服务器的图片 URL；默认主机为 mermaid.ink。

A DeepSeek Harness Plugin for Previewing Mermaid Diagram Images

Preview Mermaid syntax as images via local rendering in DSH when a chat message contains a Mermaid fenced code block (` ```mermaid ` or ` ```mmd `).

@baconbao/dsh-mermaid-image-preview README · Features and how it works：- **Preview mermaid diagrams by rendering images directly!**
- **Local renderer first!** If it fails, it can fall back to an external or self-hosted rendering engine by configuring a fallback server.
- **Nothing gets replaced:** the preview is added below the agent's reply, so
  the original messages are not covered up or changed.
- Settings in Plugin page: adjust the plugin's runtime settings in the Plugins panel - no restart needed.
- Light/dark themes follow the UI automatically.

@baconbao/dsh-mermaid-image-preview README · Support diagram types：The plugin renders diagrams locally with a built-in renderer. It supports
13 diagram types out of the box.

**Rendered locally:** flowchart, sequenceDiagram, classDiagram, stateDiagram, erDiagram, pie, journey, gitGraph, requirementDiagram, timeline, quadrantChart, packet-beta, xychart-beta

**Expand:** gantt, mindmap, block-beta, sankey-beta, architecture-beta, zenuml, C4Context

> [!NOTE]
> You can enable the fallback to render expanded types — see **Configuration** below.

section: Change runtime settings on the plugin page

text:
@baconbao/dsh-mermaid-image-preview README · Change render server via configuration file：Diagrams are rendered locally by default. To use your own render server or
enable the external fallback, edit the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (e.g.
`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` for WebUI, or `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` for Desktop):

```yaml
- id: ui-dsh-mermaid-image-preview
  config:
    enableLocalRender: true
    fallbackRenderUrl: https://mermaid.ink
section: Change render server via configuration file

text:
@baconbao/dsh-mermaid-image-preview README · Change render server via configuration file：- `enableLocalRender`: render locally (default `true`). Set it to `false` to always use the fallback server (`enableFallback` is ignored).
- `fallbackRenderUrl`: fallback render server (default `https://mermaid.ink`).
- `enableFallback`: use the fallback server when local rendering fails (default `false`).
- Restart DSH after changing these settings.
- To host your own fallback render server, see <https://github.com/jihchi/mermaid.ink> for the details.
